## Exit Stage misses automatic Journey return flip — diagnosis 2026-10-25

User reports Beach06 Exit→BeachJourney no automatic Unit card flip. Source-confirmed routing gap:NativeEndRunOwner exit saves and runs board exit,then Bootstrap.finishGameplayExit→AppController.returnFromGameplay without prepareGameplayReturn. Only ready returnPreparation branch calls incoming.enter(terminal:true);ordinary Exit fallback reveal(returnRoute)→finishPreparedWorldEntry calls enter() with defaultterminalfalse.
